name: FacetTopologyAnalyzer
description:
Initializer for filling adjacency geometry data for facets.

Common vertices and common edges are identified and mutual angle between facet faces is written to Facet instances. If facets don't move with respect to each other, this must be done only at the beginng.

attributes.name: commonEdgesFound
attributes.description: how many common edges were identified during last run. |yupdate|

attributes.name: commonVerticesFound
attributes.description: how many common vertices were identified during last run. |yupdate|

attributes.name: projectionAxis
attributes.description: Axis along which to do the initial vertex sort

attributes.name: relTolerance
attributes.description: maximum distance of 'identical' vertices, relative to minimum facet size
